MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1: Hard to run or swing a weapon. Why not have a rest in a comfy chair?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2: Can barely jog or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3: Can barely walk or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4: Can barely move or swing a weapon.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3: Shaking hands. Impossible to think straight. Make it stop!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4: You're at your limit! This can't go on...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2: It's well past your bedtime. Growing weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3: Can barely think straight. Weak with tiredness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4: So weak and tired. Desperately, inhumanly tired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl1: Could do with a bite to eat.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2: Could eat a horse right now. Growing weaker.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4: Just a crumb, a berry, a cockroach, anything...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl1: Do your best to remain calm.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4: Increasing danger of becoming rat food.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2: Why does nothing interesting ever happen around here?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3: Can barely take it any more. Isn't there ANYTHING fun to do?
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4: They never said the end of the world would be like this...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2: You always feel on the edge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4: What's the point in going on? Nothing good will ever happen...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1: Slightly damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2: Damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl4: You're going to catch a cold!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3: Sneezing and coughing. You feel sick and slow.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4: Continually coughing and sneezing. You'd better look after yourself.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3: Severely weakened by injuries or illness.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4: Not going gently into that good night...
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2: Throbbing pain. It's hard to keep focused.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3: The pain brings tears to your eyes. It's hard to go on.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4: Searing pain shoots through your body. It's hard to even think.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2: Carrying too much. You're slowed by the weight.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3: Carrying far too much. You can barely move.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4: Can't take much more! You're going to hurt yourself carrying all that.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2: Had one too many. Co-ordination slightly impaired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3: Had a few too many. Co-ordination impaired.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4: 'Iss you an' me 'gainst the wurld. I love you. I LOVE YOU.'
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4: This is how you died. High risk of becoming rat food.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4: Sudden attraction to gunshots, house alarms, and human flesh.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1: Gnawing hunger entirely absent. For now.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2: Tummy full. Goodness making its way through your system.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3: Stomach contented. You feel healthier and stronger.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl4: Couldn't manage another single, solitary bite.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_lv: Consider wearing less clothing. You feel thirstier.
Nauseous, unable to concentrate, and desperate for liquids.
Delirious. The heat is melting your life away. Get somewhere colder!
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lvl: It feels a bit nippy round here...
You need to find ways to keep warm.
Man alive, it is SO cold.
You're going out. You may be some time.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl1: The wind's making it feel a little colder.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl2: The wind's making it feel somewhat colder.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl3: The wind's making it feel a lot colder.
MEE_Vanilla_Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4: The wind feels like you're being stabbed with icicles.
